title: Task progress update
description: Published by the worker to exchange tenant.task-updates with routing key task_update.<status>. AMQP message_id = message_id (the idempotency key), correlation_id = task_id. A task produces two updates: in_progress, then done or failed. Consumers must ignore unknown properties.

message_id.description: Idempotency key, unique per logical update and stable across redeliveries and worker reruns: <task_id>:in_progress or <task_id>:outcome. Both outcomes (done, failed) share the outcome ID, so only the first one recorded counts.

task_id.description: ID of the task this update is about (the task event's id).

previous_status.description: Status the worker moved the task from; previous_status -> status is the reported transition.

reason.description: Why the task failed. Present only when status is failed.

occurred_at.description: When the worker made the transition; ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds and a Z suffix.
